messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Arrow-key navigation is restored: unmodified arrow keys move focus within the board, stop at its edges, and don’t activate cards. Modified keys, Enter, Space, and Tab keep their browser behavior. The existing remembered tab stop and focus scrolling remain in place.

The handler is in [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts), connected through [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx) and [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx). I didn’t run tests.
